```bash

at tests/integration/packing_test.py:78

```
kevin: can someone bisect? This started after the model-cache change yesterday (PR #2894). @sam you touched batching; want me to try a narrow rerun first?
sam: I can kick a rerun of the failing matrix (node: cuda-rt-40, sequence: 2048). Doing: `./tools/ci/rerun --job=ci-nightly-bench --matrix=packing,cuda-rt-40,2048` now.
deploy-bot: Rerun triggered by sam at 1762345660 — job id ci-rerun-3421

kevin: if rerun fails again, please bisect between commit a1b2c3 (yesterday morning) and f4e5d6 (last green). I can run binary bisect job.
sam: rerun completed: 1/3 failed, same assertion. Starting bisect job: `./tools/ci/bisect --range a1b2c3..f4e5d6 --test runner.integration.packing` — ETA ~40m

ci-bot: quarantine added: tests/integration/packing_test.py — reason: flaky timeout/assert — added by maria
sam: bisect found the culprit: commit e9d3f2 changed KV cache warmup timing. Revert candidate: e9d3f2
carla: confirmed locally with stress -r100, flake reproduces on e9d3f2. Opening bug + PR to add guard and a timeout tweak. I'll add test-flaky label.
maria: thanks all. leaving follow-up tasks: carla to PR, sam to add a short-term skip on master, kevin to monitor next 3 nights. :thumbsup:
kevin: noted, I'll watch nightly dashboards and post an update if anything else pops up.
